gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-momo-trust-disp: Funnel Display draws every letter with a spaghetti-like line that never swells or thins, and its c tips stay well apart. Momo Trust Display drifts along beneath, loose and generous in height.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mukta-mahee: Funnel Display looks like stencil-cut noodles of one width. Mukta Mahee gives it chunky, tall lowercase underneath, a friendly plain sans that makes the heading's thin, commanding line feel grounded.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-narnoor: Wiry and unhurried, Funnel Display looks drawn with a fixed pen, every stroke the same width. Narnoor takes over below with short ascenders over big bowls, and the two sit together like a loud voice and a steady one.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-port-lligat-san: Port Lligat Sans packs its characters in tight, like pins in a cushion. Funnel Display above it has no hairlines to squint at, so the pair's strongest quality is how cleanly both hold up at small sizes.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-secular-one: Round-bellied and heavy in the middle, Secular One swallows the line's height with zero modulation, while Funnel Display above it draws spaghetti-like strokes with an expressive pull. Their strongest quality is how little either one fusses.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-smooch-sans: Funnel Display lays fine rope in letter shapes, each stroke matching the next in width. And Smooch Sans, a sans-serif with a high midline and gaps that nearly vanish, reads as a tight, tidy run of text underneath.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sofia-sans-cond: Sofia Sans Condensed reads friendly and compact, with a big x-height and curves where the pen lifts and leaves loops unfinished. And Funnel Display, drawn in spaghetti-thin strokes of one width, gives that warmth a commanding front door.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 stands tall, so its ascenders look short, and that gives it a tidy, approachable feel. But Funnel Display brings bold letters with no thick or thin strokes, which makes the pair feel crisp and unmistakably consistent.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu reads modern, with a lofty lowercase band. Funnel Display keeps hairline-free, swell-free letterforms up top, so a long passage would move along smoothly, with the body doing the quiet carrying.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-voces: Commanding and expressive, Funnel Display is best at making a constant-width pen line look striking. And Voces does what it does best below, building tall lowercase with a low-key thick-thin variation that reads professional and neutral.
